notes.title: Dev Plays through Demo, Talks about Solo-Deving, Talks about Full Release Plans
notes.content:
[h1]Play the Demo of Ghost Knight: A Dark Tale + NextFest Stream by the Solo Dev[/h1]

[h2]Watch the Live Stream![/h2]
The solo-developer of Ghost Knight: A Dark Tale will be playing through the demo and answering questions. June 10th at 1:00PM Pacific Time.

[h2]
Add Ghost Knight: A Dark Tale to your Wishlist![/h2]
Please Wishlist the game to be notified of its release date.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374810/Ghost_Knight_A_Dark_Tale/

[h2]Check out the trailer here![/h2]
For behind the scenes info check out the devlogs as well. [previewyoutube=x8afLFwMXkE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Story[/h2]
Ghost Knight: A Dark Tale is an atmospheric action platformer that immerses you in a vividly colorful haunting world, where a deranged king, obsessed with immortality, rips open portals to a nightmarish dimension. Fight your way through undead, creatures, and beasts to stop the king's mad quest.

[h2]Features:[/h2]
●Spectral Hero:
Play as Ghost Knight, a spirit bound to a suit of armor, and harness otherworldly powers to navigate a perilous world.
●A Haunting World:
Immerse yourself in a toon-style dark fantasy world, featuring atmospheric visuals.
●Enhanced Retro-Feel:
Timeless side-scrolling gameplay enhanced with contemporary 3D art.
●Epic Action and Platforming:
Jump, Double-Jump, and Dash through tight platforming sections.
●Enemy Variety:
Fight your way through diverse enemies (So far 30 Enemy Types with different behaviors)
●Tough Boss Fights:
Test your skills against difficult bosses and absorb their souls to trade and upgrade your skills and armor. 

[url=https://www.ghostknightgame.com/gifs][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6271a215f4ddc04167344698/2d74ac56-9990-4493-97fa-fc07d81d1cc7/Boss_02.gif?format=1000w[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.ghostknightgame.com/gifs][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6271a215f4ddc04167344698/9340199f-8442-4fab-b7a6-71b44ad579c6/Action_01.gif?format=1000w[/img][/url]
